listingTitle: Art3d 10-Pack Marble Tile Peel and Stick Backsplash, 12 x 12 in, Jade Green
listingLines: Textured 3D Surface: Realistic dimensional detailing adds depth and definition, giving your wall a more authentic tile-like appearance.
Simple Peel & Stick Installation: Skip the grout and extra glue—just peel off the backing and apply for a simpler DIY project.
Jade Green Style: Rich jade green tones bring distinctive character and an eye-catching accent to your wall.
Standard Size & Value Pack: Includes 10 self-adhesive tile sheets measuring 12 x 12 inches for your wall makeover project.
Versatile Wall Decor: Suitable for kitchen backsplashes, laundry rooms, and other decorative wall applications.
summary: Add a touch of elegance to your home with these realistic marble-look peel and stick tiles. They offer a simple way to update your walls without the mess of traditional tiling.
highlights: Tiles feature a textured 3D surface for a realistic, authentic tile appearance.
Installation is straightforward with a simple peel and stick application, no grout or extra glue needed.
The rich jade green color provides distinctive character and an eye-catching accent.
Each pack includes 10 self-adhesive tile sheets, with each sheet measuring 12 x 12 inches.
stylingTips: Use the jade green tiles to create a striking focal point behind your kitchen counters.
Pair the rich green tones with neutral cabinetry or appliances to make the tiles stand out.
Consider applying these tiles to a small accent wall in a dining area for a unique decorative touch.
beforeYouBuy: Verify that the 12 x 12 inch size of each tile sheet is suitable for your project area.
Review the jade green color in your home's lighting to ensure it complements your existing decor.
